topics.name: Quantity Value
topics.purpose: Define numeric quantities as exact value plus explicit unit and precision metadata rather than unitless numbers where unit is semantically required.

semantics.unit_rule: Exact unit identity is required for unit-bearing quantities.
semantics.precision_rule: Stored/measurement precision is explicit where material.
semantics.conversion_rule: Converted value retains source/conversion provenance where material.
semantics.comparison_rule: Comparisons require compatible dimensions and explicit conversion semantics.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: display rounded value stored as source silently
